questions.question: If the side of the equilateral triangle is 8√3 cm, then what is the length (in cm) of the inradius of the triangle?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

For an equilateral triangle with side ‘a’ units, length of inradius = a√3/6 units

Given, the side of the equilateral triangle = 8√3 cm

Length of inradius = 8√3 × √3/6

= 24/6

= 4 cm

**∴ The length of the inradius is 4 cm**

questions.question: The population of a town is 350000. It increases annually at the rate of 20%. What will be the population after 2 years?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

If the current population of a town is P and it increases at a rate of R% per annum, then,

Population after n years = P × (1 + R/100)²

Given, P = 350000, R = 20%,

**∴ Population after 2 years = 350000 × (1 + 20/100)² = 350000 × 1.44 = 504000**

questions.question: Akash starts a business with Rs. 85000 and Payal joins him with Rs. 102000. If the profit at the end of a year is divided in the ratio 1 : 1, then after how many months did Payal join Akash?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Investment of Akash = Rs. 85000

Investment of Payal = Rs. 102000

Profit is divided among them in the ratio of 1: 1

**CALCULATION:**

Akash’s total capital investment = 85000 × 12 = 1020000

Let Payal join Akash after ‘x’ months

⇒ Payal’s investment time = (12 – x)

⇒ Payal’s total capital investment = 102000 × (12 – x)

Now, the Ratio of profits = Ratio of total capital investments

⇒ 1∶ 1 = 1020000∶ [102000(12 – x)]

⇒ 102000(12 – x) = 1020000

⇒ 12 – x = 10

⇒ x = 12 – 10 = 2

**∴ Payal joined after 2 months**

questions.question: What is the average of all the one digit, two digit and three digit natural numbers?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

As we know, all the one-digit, two-digit, and 3-digit natural numbers are from 1 – 999

∵ Sum of n natural numbers = n(n + 1)/2

Sum of 999 natural numbers = (999 × 1000)/2

= 499500

**∴ Required average = 499500/999 = 500**

questions.question: If the time increases by 7 years, then the simple interest increases by Rs.8400 on a sum of Rs.6000. What is the rate (in percentage) of interest per annum?
questions.solution:
Short Trick:

Interest for 7 years = Rs. 8400

∴ Interest for 1 year = 8400/7 = Rs. 1200

Rate of interest = Interest/Principle = 1200/6000 × 100 = 20%

**Detailed Solution:**

Let the rate of interest be R%

As we know, Simple interest = (Principal × Rate × Time)/100

Given, Principal = Rs. 6000

Simple interest for 7 years = (6000 × R × 7)/100

⇒ 8400 = 420R

⇒ R = 8400/420 = 20%

**∴ Rate of interest = 20% p.a.**

questions.question: Cost price of a refrigerator is Rs. 13400. If loss percentage is 4%, then what is the selling price (in Rs.) of the refrigerator?
questions.solution:
Cost price = Rs. 13400

Loss = 4% of 13400 = 4/100 × 13400 = Rs. 536

∵ Selling price = Cost price – Loss

∴ Selling price = 13400 – 536 = Rs. 12864

questions.question: On Selling a toy at 20/31 of the marked price there is a loss of 20%. What will be the ratio of marked price and cost price of the toy?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Selling price = (20/31) × Marked price(MP)

Now, Cost price – Loss = Selling price

⇒ CP – 20% of CP = (20/31) × MP

⇒ 80% of CP = (20/31) × MP

⇒ 4/5 × CP = 20/31 × MP

⇒ MP/CP = 4/5 × 31/20 = 31/25

**∴ Ratio of marked price and cost price = 31 ∶ 25**

Two pipes X and Y can fill an empty tank in 16 hours and 20 hours respectively. Pipe Z alone can empty the completely filled tank in 25 hours. Firstly both pipes X and Y are opened and after 6 hours pipe Z is also opened. What will be the total time (in hours) taken to completely fill the tank?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Let the tank be filled in ‘a’ hrs.

Part filled by X in 1 hr. = 1/16

⇒ Part filled by X in a hrs. = a/16

Part filled by Y in 1 hr. = 1/20

⇒ Part filled by Y in a hrs. = a/20

Part emptied by Z in 1 hr. = 1/25

⇒ Part emptied by Z in (a – 6) hrs. = (a – 6)/25

Now, Total work done = 1

⇒ a/16 + a/20 – (a – 6)/25 = 1

⇒ a(1/16 + 1/20 – 1/25) = 1 – 6/25

⇒ a(29/400) = 19/25

⇒ a = 400/29 × 19/25

⇒ a = 304/29

**∴ The tank will be filled in 304/29 hrs.**

questions.question: A person crosses a 700 metres wide road in 120 seconds. What is his speed (in km/hr)?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

∵ Speed = Distance/Time

⇒ Speed of man = 700/120 = 35/6 m/sec.

**∴ Speed of man = 35/6 × 18/5 = 21 km/hr.**

questions.question: If on an average Rs. 20 lakhs was paid as insurance for each death due to a heart attack, then how much insurance was paid (in Rs crore) in the year 2013?
questions.solution:
No. of deaths in 2013 = 500

Average insurance paid for each death = Rs. 20 lakhs

∴ Total insurance paid in 2013 = 500 × 20 lakhs = Rs. 10000 lakhs = Rs. 100 crores

questions.question: What must be the length (in cm) of the diagonal of a rectangle if its area and breadth are 60 cm² and 5 cm respectively?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Area of rectangle = 60 cm²

Breadth of rectangle = 5 cm 

**Concept used:**

Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth

**Calculations:**

Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth

⇒ 60 = Length × 5

⇒ Length = 60/5 = 12 cm

⇒ Diagonal of rectangle = √(length² + breadth²)

⇒ Diagonal of rectangle = √(144 + 25) = √169 = 13 cm

**∴ Diagonal of rectangle is 13 cm.**

questions.question: The area of a circle is 616 cm². What is its circumference (in cm).
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Area of the circle with radius ‘r’ = πr²

⇒ 22/7 × r² = 616

⇒ r² = 196

⇒ r = √196 = 14 cm

**∴ Circumference of circle = 2πr = 2 × 22/7 × 14 = 88 cm**

questions.question: What is the curved surface area (in cm²) of a hemisphere of diameter 42 cm?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

The total surface area of a hemisphere of radius ‘r’ = 3πr2

The curved surface area of a hemisphere of radius ‘r’ = 2πr²

Radius of hemisphere = 42/2 = 21 cm

**∴ Curved surface area of given hemisphere = 2 × 22/7 × 21 × 21 = 2772 cm²**
